name: atris-share
description: Local-first social workspace — desktop and persistent context preview.

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @atris-share/desktop
scripts.test: npm run build:core && node --test tests/storage.test.mjs tests/api.test.mjs tests/youtube.test.mjs tests/youtube-publishing.test.mjs tests/media-engine.test.mjs tests/studio.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.tauri:dev: npm run build:core && npm run tauri:dev -w @atris-share/desktop
